qualification_detail: all mandatory single-device cases passed on every present device
limits: This is a platform probe, not a model or relay qualification (guide 31.7).
Single-device results do not qualify five-rank cross-device behavior.
Wall-clock ordering observations use the host steady clock.
host_system_rmw is an independent capability; the relay design must not require it.

multi_consumer, delayed_consumer, two_bank, varying_live, five_stream, same_stream_inverse_dependency, dual_window_independent_progress, service_loop_independent_progress, nonfinite_reduction_gate, and five_rank_indexing use one device with concurrent streams; they verify protocol software and five-rank kernel indexing, not five-device qualification.
delayed_consumer_ordering gates on a >=40 ms device pause, like producer_delay_ordering.
native synchronizations are bounded at 60 s each; native_sync_deadline exercises the timeout path at 2 s on the live device.
